2 c)To direction for S.R. No. 262628/29.12.2018 and S.R. No. 608/09-01-2018 for O.S.
No. of 2018 under Order VII Rule 1 and 2 reads with Section 26 of Civil P recorded code on the file of Hon'ble Principal District and Sessions Judge, District Court Building, Kadapa City- 516001, A.P. d) To Direct the Respondents No. 4 not to alienate their movable and immovable properties till disposal of this petition and passing further orders in this regard.
e) Pass..."
2. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home on written instructions would submit that the petitioner is doing well, and he is not attending the Court to prosecute the matter.
3. Learned counsel representing for respondent Nos.4 and 8 would submit that as per his instructions, the matter was settled out of the Court.
4. The writ petitioner, who is appeared as Party-in-Person did not attend the Court though the matter listed under the caption 'for Dismissal'.

He was absent consecutively on 30.07.2025,
20.08.2025 and 01.09.2025 apart from today.
It appears that the writ petitioner is not interested to prosecute the writ petition.
5. Hence, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, interlocutory applications, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
JUSTICE B.V.L.N. CHAKRAVARTHI 08.09.2025.
